mechanism: After an external stop-pool raid is causally classified as accepted or rejected, do not chase. Trade only if the first later source retest acts as high resistance and resumes in the selected direction.

action.retest: first later observed 500ms bucket touching or crossing consumed source after initial state completion
action.window: five seconds beginning at first retest bucket
action.confirmation: trade-direction signed progress > 0, strict majority of observed closes on trade-direction side, and trade-direction signed turnover > 0
action.entry: first observed trade after retest-window completion plus fixed 500ms
action.target: unchanged selected pre-existing external pool from parent thesis; must remain live at entry
action.stop: one tick beyond retest-window adverse extreme

chronology.official_2024_2026: sealed unless fixed first-retest action passes

pass_gate.winner_stress: positive after deleting top 10% of positive completed events and fully rerouting
